en: Collage-style postcard with three photographs of narrow historic streets and traditional houses. The lower left image shows a cobblestone lane lined with low pastel-colored buildings with balconies and small shops. The upper right and lower right images depict old urban houses with overhanging upper floors, wooden shutters, and a mix of stone and plaster construction, typical of Balkan/Ottoman-era architecture. The word "Bijoux" appears in script at the bottom of the left image.
